title: NoSuperSecretSettings
description: Removes "Super Secret Messages..." as well as all shaders related to it.
body:
NoSuperSecretSettings mod removes "Super Secret Settings..." from settings, as well as removes all shaders that super secret settings has. 

Check out NoSnooper, which removes snooper entirely: https://modrinth.com/mod/nosnooper/

Check out NoTwitch, which removes Twitch integration: https://modrinth.com/mod/notwitch/

Check out NoTouchscreenMode, which removes "Touchscreen Mode" button from keybinds:
https://modrinth.com/mod/notouchscreenmode/

Check out NoRealms, which removes "Realms" from main menu, and "Realms Notifications" from settings:
https://modrinth.com/mod/norealms1.8/

Check out NoInvertMouse, which removes "Invert Mouse" from keybinds:
https://modrinth.com/mod/noinvertmouse/
